steps.what: Read actual collection work status, handling restrictions and staff questions in {PROJECT}
Direct activities of workers who assist in arranging, cataloguing, exhibiting, and maintaining collections of valuable materials, explaining priorities and resolving handling questions
Update the actual collection work plan in {PROJECT}, entering priorities, responsibilities and restrictions and checking all meaning
Save the updated plan in the same {PROJECT} working record

tasks.design: Configure collection and staff reference links in {PROJECT} so the actual work-plan entry reuses exact identifiers. The archivist reads status, directs staff and writes and checks priorities and restrictions; software makes no staff allocation decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Work plans can repeat collection and worker references already held in the project.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked fields reduce that repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: Fragile materials, competing work and staff learning require personal direction.
tasks.human_edge: The archivist explains handling priorities and recognises when work must change.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for collection access and national staff consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked project fields can reduce collection-reference re-entry without directing workers automatically.

assumptions: Boundary is actual staff direction and an existing work-plan update, not an invented report after every conversation. Assistants produce current work status in existing collection work; s1 verifies it. If status is oral rather than recorded, obtaining and capturing it stays manual within s1, not a free feed.

S2 produces priorities and responsibilities; s3 captures them and checks every instruction. Defaults carry only exact collection, staff and existing work identifiers. Missing identifiers require manual reconciliation; there is no model-written handling instruction.

This working plan save has notifications disabled and does not silently send assignments. Actual staff direction occurs in s2. Any later formal notice or published roster requires its own real final-version authority and send. Assistants' physical work is unchanged baseline labour, not transferred work.

Native links first; existing defaults earn no gain. The same-system save takes negligible effort, represented by minimum share 1 fully retained without self-approval. Shares are provisional active effort, not measured baseline times.
research_questions: Which plan fields are still repeated manually during actual staff direction?

already_counted.description: Status reading, personal direction and all meaningful plan writing/checks remain.

incremental.description: Check collection and worker reference mappings after configuration changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=91.3, gross=8.7; upkeep 2 gives net 6.7. Low zero if the actual work plan already links references, so do not add a duplicate tool. Staff direction and meaningful writing remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Locate and direct acquisition and display of materials

steps.what: Search and read candidate material references in the {OTHER} archival collections catalogue and source finding aids
Appraise candidate materials, provenance, condition, restrictions and relevance before deciding what acquisition and display to pursue
Locate new materials and direct their acquisition and display through actual coordination with collection staff and discussions with holders
Record actual candidate provenance, acquisition progress and display restrictions in the {OTHER} archival collections record and check meaning and sources
Save the candidate entry in the same {OTHER} archival collections record

tasks.design: Use native catalogue search and exact reference reuse in the {OTHER} archival collections system. The archivist appraises the actual material, directs acquisition and display work and writes provenance and restriction entries; no acquisition decision is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding aids and candidate records can repeat the same bibliographic references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search and copy-reference fields can remove some locating and re-entry effort.
tasks.still_hard: Authenticity, provenance gaps, donor terms and safe display need specialist judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The archivist decides whether the material belongs and under what constraints it may be shown.

ambition.what: No autonomous acquisition or public display.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for collection and provenance access; consultation under national rules if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: archival catalogue search and exact reference reuse can assist locating materials without deciding acquisition or display suitability.

assumptions: Representative episode is candidate research, appraisal and direction with an actual candidate record. Finding-aid authors and material holders supply existing descriptions and provenance; s1 reads and checks them, s2 investigates gaps and s4 captures all actual progress and restrictions. Unverified provenance remains unresolved rather than completed by software.

Only exact existing reference fields are copied; all acquisition and display meaning is written and checked by the archivist. Native search first; existing search and copied references earn no new gain. No assumed new transcription or clean donor-data feed.

Direction is distinct from signing a purchase, donor contract, transfer or publishing an exhibition. If those occur in an actual episode, add their real actors, final-version authority and separate actions; a saved candidate entry does none of them. Collection staff's physical work remains unchanged, not free new labour.

Same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without self-approval. Shares are hypotheses for this episode and must not be extrapolated across purchase, transfer and installation without their actual work.
research_questions: Which reference fields are repeatedly entered during actual candidate investigation?

already_counted.description: Source reading, appraisal, coordination and full candidate-entry meaning checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain reference mappings and catalogue search settings.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=89.65, gross=10.35; upkeep 2 gives net 8.35. Low zero for poorly indexed or already linked material, where no additional search or reference automation is introduced. Appraisal and direction retain their full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate educational and public outreach programmes

steps.what: Coordinate educational and public outreach programs, such as tours, workshops, lectures, and classes, by discussing actual needs and availability with educators and collection staff
Choose actual session structure, suitable material, staffing and accessibility arrangements and capture exact schedule fields
Transfer the chosen dates, rooms, staff and collection references into the actual {PROJECT} outreach plan
Write actual programme descriptions and access instructions and check the complete outreach plan against staff agreements and collection limits
Save the working plan in the same {PROJECT} outreach record

tasks.design: Configure exact programme-field population in {PROJECT} from the archivist's captured session choices. The archivist coordinates with people, designs the actual programme and completes the plan; saving it issues no invitation or public announcement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Confirmed dates, locations and material references may be copied manually into outreach plans.
tasks.enabler_now: Native programme fields can reuse the actual captured choices.
tasks.still_hard: Audience suitability, accessibility and collection handling need personal planning.
tasks.human_edge: The archivist balances public learning with protection of the collection.

ambition.what: No claim of additional audiences without demonstrated capacity.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for programme access and staff workflow consultation where required

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact programme fields can be populated from captured session decisions without automating outreach design.

assumptions: Boundary is actual internal programme coordination and working-plan preparation. Staff provide availability in existing coordination; s1 obtains it and s2 counts all selection and structured capture. Required fields are session, date, time, room, staff, material identifiers and access constraints. Missing or changed agreements return to human coordination.

S3 explicitly performs the proposed field population. Existing native schedule integration earns no new gain. Native configuration precedes custom code. S4 retains every description, access instruction and full-plan check; no free structured programme is assumed.

The saved working plan has automatic notices disabled. Actual invitations, public programme publication, bookings, material movement and teaching need their separate real actions and authority if included in a wider episode; none is hidden in the save. Educators' unchanged delivery work is not claimed as saving.
No author self-approval is added. Same-system save is minimum share 1 for negligible active effort, fully retained. Shares are provisional work estimates, not measured outreach baselines.
research_questions: Does capturing a session choice already populate the actual outreach plan?

already_counted.description: Coordination, programme choices and capture, full descriptions and complete plan checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain programme mappings and test handling of changed session details.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80, gross=20; upkeep 3 gives net 17. Conservative case: varied venues and access arrangements leave only 7 transfer points avoidable, giving 7-3=4. All human coordination and descriptions remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research collections to decide retention or acquisition

steps.what: Find relevant history or technology sources and item references in the {OTHER} archival catalogue and finding aids
Specialize in an area of history or technology by researching topics or items relevant to collections, reading original sources and checking provenance
Determine what should be retained or acquired using historical significance, collection scope, provenance and restrictions
Write the actual appraisal rationale and research references in the {OTHER} archival record and check every claim against its source
Save the appraisal entry in the same {OTHER} archival record

tasks.design: Use native catalogue search and exact reference reuse in the {OTHER} archival record. The archivist reads original sources, researches the subject and writes the appraisal judgement; no automated retention decision or invented citation is produced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research can involve repeated finding-aid scanning and reference entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing indexed fields and reference links can reduce those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Historical significance and provenance remain interpretive and incomplete.
tasks.human_edge: The archivist distinguishes a compelling story from supportable historical evidence.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for source and collection access; national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: catalogue search and exact reference linking can support archival research while original-source interpretation and appraisal remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is research leading to an actual recorded appraisal, not executing disposal or purchase. Finding-aid authors produce existing references; s1 checks retrieval and s2 reads and verifies original evidence. Missing sources remain unresolved and are obtained manually, not hallucinated or treated as searchable full text.

S4 captures all rationale and source selections; only exact located references default. No free structured interpretation or transcription is assumed. Appraisal writing shared with candidate work in 7638 is counted once, not twice.

Native search and reference configuration first; already available retrieval earns no new gain. Same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated. No author self-approval is invented and no disposal, acquisition or public disclosure follows automatically.
Shares and cuts are hypotheses for actual research episodes, not a measured history-research baseline.
research_questions: Which research retrieval actions remain repetitive after native search is used?

already_counted.description: Source reading, historical appraisal and all rationale/source checks remain.

incremental.description: Check reference link and search-field configuration as finding aids change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=89.1, gross=10.9; upkeep 2 gives net 8.9. Low zero for unindexed original material or research already using effective linked retrieval, so do not add a redundant tool. Original-source reading and appraisal do not shrink.

role.altitude: Less repeated source and collection-reference entry; staff direction, outreach design and historical appraisal stay with the archivist.
reach: Education coordinator: learn programme accessibility and collection handling constraints.
skills_to_grow: Measure actual programme and appraisal writing
role.ambitious_version: An archivist who can trace work plans and acquisition rationales to sources while personally directing people and protecting collection meaning.
